product_one_liner.value: Druid AI is an enterprise platform for building, deploying and orchestrating AI agents that automate business processes and connect enterprise systems with people.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL is a custom-pricing inquiry form, with no named plans, tiers or prices; it qualifies as a bare contact form under the requested rule.

named_customers.notes: Named as customers on the company homepage.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn identifies druidai.com and reports 224 employees as of September 30, 2026; LeadIQ reports approximately 222 as of October 2026. These recent counts outweigh LinkedIn's broader, conflicting 51–200 classification.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies New York as the primary headquarters; London and Bucharest are additional offices.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog is primarily business, industry and product guidance. The technical-looking reference-model article is general production-agent evaluation guidance, not an explanation of Druid's internals, and does not establish an engineering author. No two qualifying engineering posts were found.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes platform concepts, deployment, portal guides and detailed knowledge-base configuration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists Technical Consultant in Bucharest as its only current opening; no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title is listed.

model_provider.value: Azure OpenAI; Anthropic Claude; Google Gemini; Meta LLaMA; Mistral; Druid Becus LLM.
model_provider.notes: The governance page explicitly names these supported models/providers and also supports bring-your-own-model configurations; this does not imply every customer deployment uses all of them.

compliance_certs.notes: The page publicly claims support for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, GDPR and HIPAA through its documented and audited control framework. GDPR and HIPAA are compliance claims rather than independent certifications. No PCI DSS claim was found.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 16, 2025; led by Cipio Partners. This is the latest disclosed round found.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 16, 2025 Series C falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists only a Technical Consultant opening, with no SDR, BDR or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying product or major-feature launch was found during May 9–November 9, 2026 in the readable news and blog histories. The latest platform launch found was Virtual Authoring Teams, announced October 24, 2025. The May 20, 2026 production-data report is research, not a product launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP hire/departure was verified during November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. The stories directory lacks start dates and is stale: it still lists Liviu Drăgan as CEO despite Joseph Kim's September 2025 appointment. It cannot substantiate a negative. The required boolean value is a schema placeholder, not an asserted false.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are explicitly named on the integrations page. This is evidence of supported integrations, not proof that Druid uses them internally.
